selected_script.angle: Vacuuming a rug without it sliding away or corners lifting
selected_script.hook: Every time I vacuum, this area rug moves everywhere.

scene_01.voiceover: Every time I vacuum, this area rug slides all over the place. But I found a simple way to keep it completely flat.

scene_02.voiceover: These thin L-shaped corner stickers stick directly to the underside. They lay fully flat, so they stay completely invisible.

scene_03.voiceover: Now my rug stays secure and perfectly flat. It makes cleaning so much easier. You definitely need this set!
